entry_point: 3LC Hub Kaggle Competition plugin 1.2.15; enter these settings in its UI. This file is a record, not an alternative training pipeline.
effective_notes: optimizer=auto overrides the requested learning rate; per-group rates are recorded in epoch-results.csv.
epochs=10 and close_mosaic=10 disabled mosaic before epoch 1, despite the configured mosaic=1.0.
Actual device was cuda:0. Each new experiment must restart from the official pinned checkpoint.
